title.zh: 将布阿扬小学更名为达图·阿卡德·达利德中心小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Buayan Elementary School to Datu Acad Dalid Central Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Buayan Elementary School to Datu Acad Dalid Central Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Buayan thành Trường tiểu học Datu Acad Dalid Central
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Buayan เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Datu Acad Dalid Central
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Buayan menjadi Sekolah Dasar Datu Acad Dalid Central
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Buayan menjadi Sekolah Rendah Datu Acad Dalid Central

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6824_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Buayan Elementary School in General Santos City, Province of South Cotabato, shall hereafter be known and referred to as the Datu Acad Dalid Central Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.

titleTranslation.source: An Act Changing the Name of the Buayan Elementary School to Datu Acad Dalid Central Elementary School
